description_en: Nepal's holiest Hindu temple, on the banks of the Bagmati River and part of the Kathmandu Valley UNESCO World Heritage Site. Only Hindus may enter the main temple, but visitors can watch the ghats and the evening aarti from across the river.
how_to_reach_en: About 5 km east of central Kathmandu near Gaushala; 15-20 minutes by taxi or microbus.
description_ne: बागमती नदीको किनारमा रहेको पशुपतिनाथ नेपालको सबैभन्दा पवित्र हिन्दु मन्दिर हो र युनेस्को विश्व सम्पदा सूचीमा सूचीकृत छ। मुख्य मन्दिरमा हिन्दुहरूले मात्र प्रवेश गर्न पाउँछन्, तर नदीपारिबाट घाट र साँझको आरती हेर्न सकिन्छ।
how_to_reach_ne: काठमाडौँको केन्द्रबाट करिब ५ किलोमिटर पूर्व, गौशाला नजिक। ट्याक्सी वा माइक्रोबसबाट १५–२० मिनेट।

description_en: An ancient Buddhist stupa on a hill west of Kathmandu with wide views over the city. The many monkeys around it give it the nickname Monkey Temple.
how_to_reach_en: About 3 km west of Thamel: a 30-minute walk or 10 minutes by taxi. The eastern stairway has more than 365 steps.
description_ne: काठमाडौँ उपत्यकाको पश्चिमी पहाडमा रहेको प्राचीन बौद्ध स्तूप, जहाँबाट सहरको सुन्दर दृश्य देखिन्छ। यहाँ धेरै बाँदर भएकाले यसलाई मंकी टेम्पल पनि भनिन्छ।
how_to_reach_ne: ठमेलबाट करिब ३ किलोमिटर पश्चिम। हिँडेर ३० मिनेट वा ट्याक्सीमा १० मिनेट; पूर्वी ढोकाबाट ३६५ भन्दा बढी खुड्किला चढ्नुपर्छ।

description_en: One of the largest stupas in Nepal and the centre of Tibetan Buddhist culture in Kathmandu, surrounded by monasteries, shops and rooftop cafes.
how_to_reach_en: About 7 km east of central Kathmandu; taxi or bus to Boudha Chowk.
description_ne: नेपालकै सबैभन्दा ठूलो स्तूपमध्ये एक र काठमाडौँमा तिब्बती बौद्ध संस्कृतिको केन्द्र। स्तूपको वरिपरि गुम्बा, पसल र क्याफेहरू छन्।
how_to_reach_ne: काठमाडौँको केन्द्रबाट करिब ७ किलोमिटर पूर्व; ट्याक्सी वा बसबाट बौद्ध चोकसम्म।

description_en: The old royal square of Kathmandu with palaces, courtyards and temples from the Malla and Shah periods, including Hanuman Dhoka palace and the Kumari Ghar.
how_to_reach_en: About 1.5 km south of Thamel; a 20-minute walk.
description_ne: मल्ल र शाह कालका दरबार, मन्दिर र चोकहरू भएको ऐतिहासिक क्षेत्र। कुमारी घर र हनुमानढोका दरबार यहीँ छन्।
how_to_reach_ne: ठमेलबाट करिब १.५ किलोमिटर दक्षिण; हिँडेर २० मिनेट।

description_en: The royal square of Lalitpur, known for Newar architecture, the stone Krishna Mandir and the Patan Museum.
how_to_reach_en: About 5 km south of Thamel across the Bagmati; 20 minutes by taxi.

description_en: A well-preserved medieval Newar town with the Palace of 55 Windows, the five-storey Nyatapola temple and famous juju dhau (king curd).
how_to_reach_en: About 13 km east of Kathmandu; 45 minutes by bus or taxi.
description_ne: नेवार कला र वास्तुकलाका लागि प्रसिद्ध मध्यकालीन सहर। ५५ झ्याले दरबार, पाँचतले न्यातपोल मन्दिर र जुजु धौ यहाँका प्रमुख आकर्षण हुन्।
how_to_reach_ne: काठमाडौँबाट करिब १३ किलोमिटर पूर्व; बस वा ट्याक्सीबाट ४५ मिनेट।

description_en: Thought to be the oldest temple in the Kathmandu Valley, a hilltop Vishnu temple with fine stone and wood carvings.
how_to_reach_en: About 6 km north of Bhaktapur; bus or taxi from Bhaktapur, or a 2-hour hike from Nagarkot.

description_en: A hill station on the valley rim, popular for sunrise views of the Himalaya from Langtang to Everest on clear days.
how_to_reach_en: About 30 km east of Kathmandu; 1.5 hours by bus or car via Bhaktapur.

description_en: Pokhara's best-known lake, with Machhapuchhre reflected in calm water. Boats cross to the Tal Barahi temple on an island in the lake.
how_to_reach_en: Next to Lakeside, Pokhara. Kathmandu to Pokhara takes 6-7 hours by tourist bus or 25 minutes by plane.
description_ne: पोखराको सबैभन्दा प्रसिद्ध ताल, जसमा माछापुच्छ्रे हिमालको प्रतिबिम्ब देखिन्छ। डुङ्गा चढेर तालबीचको ताल बाराही मन्दिर पुग्न सकिन्छ।
how_to_reach_ne: पोखराको लेकसाइडबाट सिधै पुगिन्छ; काठमाडौँबाट पर्यटक बसमा ६–७ घण्टा वा हवाईजहाजमा २५ मिनेट।

description_en: A hilltop above Pokhara with sunrise views of Dhaulagiri, the Annapurnas and Machhapuchhre. Paragliding flights take off from here.
how_to_reach_en: About 30 minutes by car from Lakeside, or a 2-3 hour walk uphill.
description_ne: पोखरा नजिकको पहाडी दृश्यस्थल, जहाँबाट धौलागिरि, अन्नपूर्ण र माछापुच्छ्रे हिमालमा सूर्योदय हेर्न सकिन्छ। प्याराग्लाइडिङ यहीँबाट उड्छ।
how_to_reach_ne: लेकसाइडबाट गाडीमा करिब ३० मिनेट, वा हिँडेर २–३ घण्टा उकालो।

description_en: A white Buddhist stupa on the ridge south of Phewa Lake with views over Pokhara and the Annapurna range.
how_to_reach_en: Take a boat across Phewa Lake and hike up for about an hour, or drive up in 30 minutes.

description_en: A hilltop temple of the goddess Bhagwati, believed to grant wishes. Most visitors ride the cable car up from Kurintar.
how_to_reach_en: Cable car from Kurintar on the Prithvi Highway, about 3 hours' drive from Kathmandu (cable car ticket paid separately).

description_en: Nepal's largest lake, a clear blue lake surrounded by pine forest inside Rara National Park in the remote far west.
how_to_reach_en: Fly to Talcha airport from Nepalgunj, then walk about 3 hours; or a long jeep journey via Surkhet and Jumla.

description_en: Nepal's first national park and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, home to one-horned rhinoceros, Bengal tigers, gharial crocodiles and hundreds of bird species.
how_to_reach_en: Tourist bus from Kathmandu to Sauraha (5-6 hours), or fly to Bharatpur (20 minutes).
description_ne: युनेस्को विश्व सम्पदामा सूचीकृत नेपालको पहिलो राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज। यहाँ एकसिङ्गे गैँडा, बाघ, घडियाल गोही र सयौँ प्रजातिका चराहरू पाइन्छन्।
how_to_reach_ne: काठमाडौँबाट सौराहासम्म पर्यटक बसमा ५–६ घण्टा, वा भरतपुरसम्म हवाईजहाजमा २० मिनेट।

description_en: A large, quiet national park in western Nepal and one of the best places in the country to see wild tigers.
how_to_reach_en: Fly to Nepalgunj, then about 2.5 hours by road to Thakurdwara.

description_en: The birthplace of the Buddha and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Maya Devi Temple protects the marker stone of the birth spot; monasteries from many countries stand in the surrounding garden.
how_to_reach_en: About 22 km from Bhairahawa (Gautam Buddha International Airport); 8-9 hours by bus from Kathmandu.
description_ne: भगवान् गौतम बुद्धको जन्मस्थल र युनेस्को विश्व सम्पदा स्थल। मायादेवी मन्दिरभित्र बुद्ध जन्मेको ठाउँ चिनाउने शिला सुरक्षित छ र वरिपरि विभिन्न देशका गुम्बाहरू छन्।
how_to_reach_ne: भैरहवा (गौतम बुद्ध अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय विमानस्थल) बाट करिब २२ किलोमिटर; काठमाडौँबाट बसमा ८–९ घण्टा।

description_en: A white marble temple in Janakpur dedicated to Sita, built in a Hindu-Rajput style and busy during Vivaha Panchami.
how_to_reach_en: Fly to Janakpur from Kathmandu (30 minutes) or about 8 hours by bus.

description_en: Road-head village on the Pokhara-Baglung road and a common starting point for Poon Hill and Annapurna treks.
how_to_reach_en: About 1.5 hours by jeep or bus from Pokhara.

description_en: A small teahouse village by the Bhurungdi Khola, the first night stop on the Poon Hill trek.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Nayapul (about 4-5 hours), or by jeep to nearby Hile.

description_en: A busy ridge-top village in rhododendron forest, the base for the sunrise hike to Poon Hill.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Tikhedhunga via the long stone staircase to Ulleri (about 6-7 hours).

description_en: A famous viewpoint above Ghorepani with sunrise views of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre. Ideal for a short, easy trek.
how_to_reach_en: An early-morning climb of about 45 minutes from Ghorepani.
description_ne: घोरेपानी माथि रहेको प्रसिद्ध दृश्यस्थल, जहाँबाट धौलागिरि, अन्नपूर्ण दक्षिण र माछापुच्छ्रे हिमालमा सूर्योदय देखिन्छ। सजिलो र छोटो पदयात्राका लागि उपयुक्त।
how_to_reach_ne: घोरेपानीबाट बिहान सबेरै करिब ४५ मिनेट उकालो हिँडेर पुगिन्छ।

description_en: A forest village with close views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre, between Ghorepani and Ghandruk.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Ghorepani (about 6 hours via Deurali pass).

description_en: A large Gurung village with stone houses, a museum and views of Annapurna South; connected by road to Pokhara.
how_to_reach_en: Jeep from Pokhara (about 3 hours), or on foot from Nayapul or Tadapani.

description_en: The last permanent village on the way into the Annapurna Sanctuary, with a long stone staircase and close views of Annapurna South.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Ghandruk or Jhinu Danda.

description_en: A cluster of lodges in bamboo forest in the Modi Khola gorge on the way to Annapurna Base Camp.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Chhomrong via Sinuwa (about 5 hours).

description_en: Lodges at the entrance of the Annapurna Sanctuary; avalanche-prone in winter and spring.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Bamboo via Dovan and Himalaya (about 5 hours).

description_en: A ring of high peaks in the Annapurna Sanctuary, with Annapurna I towering above the lodges and Machhapuchhre behind.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Deurali via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (about 4-5 hours).

description_en: A village below Chhomrong known for natural hot springs by the Modi Khola.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Chhomrong (1 hour down) or from Siwai road head.

description_en: The gateway to the Everest region, with the famous short mountain airstrip of Tenzing-Hillary Airport.
how_to_reach_en: 35-minute flight from Kathmandu (or Ramechhap/Manthali in peak season).

description_en: A riverside village on the Dudh Koshi, the usual first night of the Everest Base Camp trek.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Lukla (about 3-4 hours).

description_en: The Sherpa capital of the Khumbu, a horseshoe-shaped town with shops, bakeries and the Sagarmatha National Park visitor centre. Trekkers spend an extra day here to acclimatise.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Phakding via the Hillary Suspension Bridge (about 6 hours).

description_en: Home of Tengboche Monastery, the largest monastery in the Khumbu, with views of Ama Dablam and Everest.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Namche Bazaar (about 5-6 hours).

description_en: A village of stone-walled fields below Ama Dablam and Island Peak, used for a second acclimatisation day.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Tengboche via Pangboche (about 5-6 hours).

description_en: A windy village with the Himalayan Rescue Association aid post, often used on the way down from Everest Base Camp.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Dingboche over a low ridge, or from Lobuche going down.

description_en: A cold, high lodge settlement beside the Khumbu Glacier moraine, the last stop before Gorak Shep.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Dingboche via Thukla and the climbers' memorials (about 5 hours).

description_en: The highest lodges on the Everest trail, on a frozen lakebed, used as a base for Everest Base Camp and Kala Patthar.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Lobuche (about 3 hours).

description_en: The south base camp of Mount Everest on the Khumbu Glacier, beside the Khumbu Icefall.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Gorak Shep (about 2-3 hours each way).

description_en: A dark rocky hill above Gorak Shep with one of the best close views of Everest's summit.
how_to_reach_en: A steep 2-hour climb from Gorak Shep, usually at sunrise.

description_en: A road-head town on the Bhote Koshi, the start of the Langtang Valley trek.
how_to_reach_en: 7-8 hours by bus or jeep from Kathmandu via Dhunche.

description_en: A group of lodges in forest beside the Langtang Khola, where red pandas and langur monkeys are sometimes seen.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Syabrubesi (about 6 hours).

description_en: A Tamang village rebuilt after the 2015 earthquake landslide, in a wide valley under Langtang Lirung.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Lama Hotel via Ghodatabela (about 6-7 hours).

description_en: The last village in the Langtang Valley, with a monastery, a cheese factory and hikes to Kyanjin Ri and Tserko Ri.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Langtang Village (about 3 hours).

description_en: A road-side village on the Pokhara-Baglung road, the start of the Mardi Himal trek via Australian Camp.
how_to_reach_en: About 1 hour by jeep or bus from Pokhara.

description_en: Simple lodges in thick rhododendron forest on the Mardi Himal ridge.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Kande via Australian Camp and Pothana (about 6 hours).

description_en: Lodges on the Mardi ridge with the first close views of Machhapuchhre.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Forest Camp (about 3 hours).

description_en: The highest lodges on the Mardi Himal trek, above the tree line, facing Machhapuchhre.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Low Camp via Badal Danda (about 3 hours).

description_en: A traditional Gurung village in the Mardi Khola valley where the Mardi Himal trek usually ends; jeeps go back to Pokhara.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Low Camp (about 4 hours down), then jeep to Pokhara.

description_en: A village where the Manaslu circuit joins the Annapurna Circuit; jeeps from Besisahar reach here.
how_to_reach_en: Jeep from Besisahar (about 4-5 hours).

description_en: The headquarters of Manang district, with hot springs and views of Lamjung Himal and Annapurna II.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Dharapani (about 6 hours) or by jeep.

description_en: A stone village above the Marsyangdi with a monastery and views of Annapurna II.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Chame via the Paungda Danda rock face (about 6 hours).

description_en: The main town of the upper Marsyangdi valley and the acclimatisation stop before Thorong La; HRA altitude talks are held here in season.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Pisang via Ngawal or the lower valley route (about 6-7 hours).

description_en: Lodges in yak pastures on the climb toward Thorong La.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Manang (about 4 hours).

description_en: The base of Thorong La; trekkers start the pass crossing before dawn from here or from High Camp.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Yak Kharka via Ledar (about 3-4 hours).

description_en: The 5,416 m high point of the Annapurna Circuit and one of the highest trekking passes in the world.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Thorong Phedi (about 4-5 hours of steady climbing).

description_en: A temple sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists, with 108 water spouts and an eternal natural gas flame.
how_to_reach_en: Jeep from Jomsom (about 1.5 hours), or on foot after crossing Thorong La.

description_en: The windy headquarters of Mustang district on the Kali Gandaki, with flights to Pokhara.
how_to_reach_en: 20-minute flight from Pokhara, or a long jeep ride via Beni.

description_en: The headquarters of Rasuwa district and the start of the Gosaikunda trek; Langtang National Park permits are checked here.
how_to_reach_en: 6-7 hours by bus or jeep from Kathmandu.

description_en: A small settlement with a monastery and an old cheese factory in pine and rhododendron forest.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Dhunche via Deurali (about 6 hours).

description_en: A ridge-top stop with wide views of Langtang, Ganesh Himal and Manaslu.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Chandanbari (about 3 hours).

description_en: A sacred alpine lake visited by thousands of pilgrims at the Janai Purnima festival.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Laurebina (about 3 hours).

description_en: A village on the Budhi Gandaki where the Manaslu circuit trek usually starts.
how_to_reach_en: 8-9 hours by jeep from Kathmandu via Arughat.

description_en: A paved village at the entrance of the Manaslu Conservation Area, where permits are checked.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Machha Khola via Tatopani hot spring (about 7 hours).

description_en: A small village in the Budhi Gandaki gorge where the culture changes from Hindu to Tibetan Buddhist.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Jagat via Philim (about 7 hours).

description_en: A village with good lodges and the first views of the high Manaslu peaks.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Deng (about 7 hours).

description_en: A large Tibetan-style village below Manaslu, used for an acclimatisation day.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Namrung via Lho (about 6-7 hours).

description_en: The last village before the Larkya La, settled by people from Tibet.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Samagaun (about 3-4 hours).

description_en: Basic lodges and tents at the foot of the Larkya La pass.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Samdo (about 4 hours).

description_en: A wide grassy valley below the west side of the Larkya La, facing Himlung and Manaslu.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Dharamsala over the Larkya La (about 9 hours).

description_en: A Gurung village in the Dudh Khola valley on the way down from Bimthang.
how_to_reach_en: On foot from Bimthang (about 6 hours).
